result:
I logged two friction notes and committed them, so the op directory has nothing uncommitted.

1. **Verifier prompt, medium cost:** it doesn't say what to do when the golden harness itself is broken. Here the harness raised a TypeError on every cell before the op even ran, so no change to the op could clear the failures. The prompt only says not to edit `feature_spec.py`. I suggested a rule: patch the harness locally for diagnosis without committing it, revert it, report the defect to `/golden-tests`, and state whether the eval directory may be touched at all.
2. **`run_safe_pytest.sh --profile`, low cost:** it wrote the profiler CSV under the sibling `/localdev/kgrujcic/tt-metal` checkout that is on `PYTHONPATH`, then warned that no CSV had been produced. I had to dig the real path out of the profiler log. I suggested having the script read the path from that log, or pin the profiler output directory to this repo.
